currentPhase: v0.4.x - editor polish driven by defect reports from the test build: lists that stop cutting each other and can be left, an escapable inline format, KaTeX equations, six more code languages, a real font menu, and shapes that genuinely go behind the text.
next: Port Nebula Demo features into the rewrite one at a time via the bus/disk-store/storage hooks: graph, flashcards, command palette, search, i18n.

repository.whyPublic: electron-updater reads latest.yml from the release page with no credentials; a private repo would mean compiling a GitHub token into every copy of the app.

workflow.releasePolicy: Standing instruction (2026-09-07): release finished work with npm run push without being asked, and never ask which platforms to build - the repo is public, so Actions is free on both Windows and macOS runners. npm run push also refreshes Nebula Test.exe in the project root.

quality.smokeCommand: npm run build && npm run smoke

invariants: The dev app and the installed app never share a profile — npm run dev sets NEBULA_USER_DATA to <repo>/.dev-profile.
Sample notes are seeded only when the vault was read successfully AND came back empty. An unreadable vault disables the disk mirror instead.
The vault is copied to backups/pre-update-<version>-<time> immediately before an update installs.
electron-updater stays in dependencies and external in vite.config.js; CI asserts both latest.yml and its presence in the asar.
win.signAndEditExecutable must stay unset — false also disables rcedit, which is what writes the exe's icon and version info.
The `hidden` attribute is only a UA display:none - any author `display` rule beats it. app.css carries [hidden]{display:none!important}; assert computed display in tests, never el.hidden.
Shapes live on two layers (.shape-layer and .shape-layer--behind). 'Send behind text' moves the node between them; a class alone cannot cross a stacking context.
Starter notes depend on the build channel: seedFor('test'|'dev') gives the per-feature checklist, everything else gets the welcome note plus one help page.
npm run kill closes Nebula.exe, Nebula Test.exe and the versioned portable; pack:test runs it first, so the test build refreshes without anyone closing a window.

history.what: About panel readability, and the docs site stamps the version it was released with.
Main violet theme plus Dark and Light, a vector icon crisp at every size, and one version number across app, docs site and release.
Portable builds keep their own notes; the repo's .bat files open the dev app rather than a packed build.
A test build you can double-click: Nebula Test.exe with its own productName, appId, icon and vault at <repo>/Nebula-data.

Editor pass: lists repaired after execCommand, Enter/Backspace out of an inline format, KaTeX equations rendered from data-tex, six more code languages (C, C++, C#, Java, Dart, Ruby), sharper icons, aligned colour menus.

Exe icon and version metadata (rcedit re-enabled), AppUserModelId, About panel with build channel and folders, agent ritual (AGENTS/preflight/memory/Prompt/HANDOVER/tests), 22-check Electron smoke test, local docs site with six mind maps, gated nebula-web mirror published on every release.
Sidebar mark drawn as one closed arc path — two circles with fill-rule evenodd cannot subtract and rendered a ring.

First public release: GitHub Releases for Windows and macOS, in-app updates (silent install on Windows, notify+download elsewhere), and three data-loss fixes — shared dev/installed profile, seeding over an unreadable vault, no pre-update snapshot.
Editor v3: movable editing bar, line icons, markdown code blocks with syntax colours, free-floating shapes, tabbed AI panel, six seed notes.
